description: Tier 1 persona tasks: each request embeds a cue that signals the traveler's persona, and the rubric judge (agents.travel_persona) rates the booked trip against that hidden persona. Train tasks are New York (JFK) trips; test tasks are the same personas in Los Angeles (LAX), a held-out city, so a memorized preference list will not generalize but an adaptive cue-to-preference strategy will. All trips are 2 nights from SFO.
